_note: Model ids must be real gateway routes. Reasoning effort is NOT part of the model id; express it as `id#effort` in base.eval.models (e.g. azure/gpt-5.6-luna#none and azure/gpt-5.6-luna#low run the same route at two efforts). The models map keys are the bare base ids; tpmLimit + maxConcurrency are looked up by base id. concurrencyByModel is derived from tpmLimit*headroom, capped by maxConcurrency; a shared TPM limiter enforces tpmLimit. Valid efforts: minimal, low, medium, high, none, xhigh, max (omit to inherit the gateway default).
